D: Separation size the copies reach at the time t_d
d: Separation of two copies, in angles and angular velocities
delta: Extra turn of the upper rod from one copy to the next
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
omega_1: In the modes, the slow mode's angular frequency; in d, the upper rod's angular velocity
omega_2: In the modes, the fast mode's angular frequency; in d, the lower rod's angular velocity
t_d: Time for the copies to separate
theta_1: Angle of the upper rod from vertical
theta_2: Angle of the lower rod from vertical
